info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Sale By Param1-spec
info.description: The Customer Campaign Execution Sale Retrieval API allows businesses to efficiently access sales data linked to specific customer campaign executions. This endpoint retrieves detailed sales information based on a unique parameter, enabling users to analyze campaign performance and customer engagement. Typical consumers include marketing analysts and sales teams looking to evaluate the effectiveness of targeted promotions. By leveraging this API, organizations can make data-driven decisions to enhance their marketing strategies and improve revenue generation.

get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch detailed information about a specific customer campaign execution identified by the unique ID. It provides insights into the campaign's performance and customer engagement metrics.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve details related to the customer campaign execution for the specified customer ID. It should contain all necessary parameters and options required for the execution.

200.description: Request completed successfully and the desired customer campaign execution details are returned.

GetSaleByParam1Request.description: This schema represents the request body for the Customer Campaign Execution operation in the sales system.

prospectId.description: The unique identifier for the prospect.

productCode.description: The code representing the product associated with the campaign.

salesChannel.description: The sales channel through which the product is sold.

relationshipManagerId.description: The unique identifier for the relationship manager handling this prospect.

expectedValue.description: The expected monetary value from the campaign.

campaignObjective.description: The primary objective of the campaign.

controlGroupPercent.description: The percentage of the control group in the campaign.

contactFrequencyCap.description: The maximum number of times a prospect can be contacted during the campaign.

recordStatus.description: The current status of the record.

version.description: The version number of the campaign record.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp when the record was last updated.

metadata.description: Metadata related to the campaign execution.

GetSaleByParam1Response_200.description: This schema represents the response for the customer campaign execution API request.

amount.description: The expected amount in the specified currency.

currency.description: The currency code for the expected amount.

ExpectedValue.description: This schema represents the expected monetary value from the campaign.

responseId.description: The unique identifier for the response.

correlationId.description: The identifier used to correlate multiple requests on the same campaign.

generatedAt.description: The timestamp when the response was generated.

processingRegion.description: The region where the response was processed.

Metadata.description: This schema contains metadata related to the campaign execution.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: Identifies the endpoint that was invoked for the request.

X-Runtime-App.description: Indicates the runtime application context in which the request was processed.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses bearer tokens for authentication. The tokens are expected to be JSON Web Tokens (JWT), which provide a compact and self-contained way for securely transmitting information between parties.
